rationale.risk-routing: Decision matrix assigns autonomy and human-review tiers from independent risk signals.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines tier-specific review checkpoints, blocking authority, demotion, and exception handling.
rationale.org-governance: Specifies accountability roles, policies, registries, workflow integration, and competence governance.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent registry records delegation, ownership, rationale, provenance, and validation history.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Centers generation-speed gains producing larger validation burdens and review bottlenecks.
rationale.automation-bias: Designs competence-maintenance practices against complacency, skill erosion, and polished-output trust.
rationale.oversight-theater: Explicitly rejects rubber-stamping and ownership without time, skill, or authority.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Tier protocols prescribe tests, automated checks, sampling, and boundary monitoring.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Bounded autonomy and boundary monitoring constrain departures from delegated parameters.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality measures—error rates, false acceptance, validation effort—for tier transitions.
